subject: June News from Postman
snippet: June 2017 Postman Newsletter Postman is a CODiE Award Finalist! We are honored to have both Postman & Postman Pro named as SIIA CODiE finalists in the category of Best API management platform. Head
body:
Postman


** June 2017 Postman Newsletter
------------------------------------------------------------
Postman is a CODiE Award Finalist!

We are honored to have both Postman & Postman Pro named as SIIA CODiE finalists in the category of Best API management platform. Head to TechPortal to find out more about Postman’s nomination and the SIIA CODiE awards (https://thetechportal.com/2017/06/13/postman-siia-business-technology-codie-award-finalist/?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e6a01de1d4-EMAIL_NEWSLETTER_2017_06_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e6a01de1d4-10520483) . If you’re a SIIA member, your vote helps to select winners in each category from among the finalists. Voting (https://www.siia.net/codie/Member-Vote?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e6a01de1d4-EMAIL_NEWSLETTER_2017_06_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e6a01de1d4-10520483) for CODiE finalists across 50+ categories continues through July 7.

------------------------------------------------------------
Postman & APIDays in San Francisco

Postman’s CEO & co-founder Abhinav Asthana will be speaking at APIDays in San Francisco on July 12th! This one-day conference is organized around the theme of: Successful APIs: Building successful API companies, scalable API architecture, and reliable API integrations. Postman community members can get a 30% discount on tickets to APIDays - head here to register (https://www.eventbrite.com/e/apidays-sf-building-a-successful-api-business-and-a-scalable-api-infrastructure-tickets-33296944056?discount=POSTMAN_COMMUNITY&utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e6a01de1d4-EMAIL_NEWSLETTER_2017_06_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e6a01de1d4-10520483) .

Plus, Postman will be hosting a developer meetup here at our new San Francisco office! This free event will start at 6 p.m., on July 11th, the night before APIDays. If you’re in town, live in the Bay Area, or just want to come by to talk APIs, we’d love to see you. Space is limited! Register here for this free event (https://www.eventbrite.com/e/postman-runs-on-postman-tickets-35609646411?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e6a01de1d4-EMAIL_NEWSLETTER_2017_06_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e6a01de1d4-10520483) .
------------------------------------------------------------
New Features Beaming into Postman:

Our team is hard at work adding new features and enhancements to Postman. Here are this month’s highlights:
* Descriptions for request attributes (http://blog.getpostman.com/2017/06/03/descriptions-for-request-attributes-in-postman/?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e6a01de1d4-EMAIL_NEWSLETTER_2017_06_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e6a01de1d4-10520483)
* Mock responses using examples (http://blog.getpostman.com/2017/05/17/mock-responses-in-postman-by-using-examples/?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e6a01de1d4-EMAIL_NEWSLETTER_2017_06_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e6a01de1d4-10520483)
* Restore Postman Collections from previous versions (http://blog.getpostman.com/2017/06/20/version-control-in-postman/?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e6a01de1d4-EMAIL_NEWSLETTER_2017_06_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e6a01de1d4-10520483)
* Customize Team URLs (http://blog.getpostman.com/2017/06/06/custom-team-urls-for-pro-and-enterprise/?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e6a01de1d4-EMAIL_NEWSLETTER_2017_06_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e6a01de1d4-10520483)

------------------------------------------------------------
Not Your Grandma’s Postman

Stuck in the stone age, scrolling through your history in order to send a GET request? Find out how Postman’s features can supercharge your API development in our new blog, Not Your Grandma’s Postman (http://blog.getpostman.com/2017/05/27/not-your-grandmas-postman/?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e6a01de1d4-EMAIL_NEWSLETTER_2017_06_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e6a01de1d4-10520483) .

------------------------------------------------------------
Eight Habits of Effective Developers

Our very own Developer Evangelist Joyce Lin recently contributed to ITProPortal about the eight habits needed for effective API development. Find out why there’s more to development than testing and deploying APIs (http://www.itproportal.com/features/eight-habits-of-effective-api-developers/?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e6a01de1d4-EMAIL_NEWSLETTER_2017_06_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e6a01de1d4-10520483) .

------------------------------------------------------------
Postman recognized for helping developers collaborate!

TheNextWeb recently released a list of 5 collaboration apps developers can’t live without. Postman’s sharing and collaboration features rocketed to #2 on the list (https://thenextweb.com/contributors/2017/06/03/5-mobile-collaboration-apps-top-developers-cant-live-without/?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e6a01de1d4-EMAIL_NEWSLETTER_2017_06_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e6a01de1d4-10520483#.tnw_ELO4fpJG) .

------------------------------------------------------------
Managing Your Cloud Network With Cisco Meraki and Postman

Cisco Meraki just released a Postman Collection to help developers manage their networks with increased flexibility. Learn more on their community site (https://communities.cisco.com/community/developer/meraki/blog/2017/05/30/postman-collection-for-the-meraki-dashboard-api--updated?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e6a01de1d4-EMAIL_NEWSLETTER_2017_06_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e6a01de1d4-10520483) , or get started with their API documentation (https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/897512/meraki-technician-app-workshop/2SLWzK?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e6a01de1d4-EMAIL_NEWSLETTER_2017_06_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e6a01de1d4-10520483) . Cisco publishes their API documentation using Postman - read how to do that here (https://www.getpostman.com/docs/postman/api_documentation/intro_to_api_documentation?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e6a01de1d4-EMAIL_NEWSLETTER_2017_06_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e6a01de1d4-10520483) .

------------------------------------------------------------
API Development With The Postman Community:

* N Th blogs about using Postman Tests and Environments to automate Azure access token procurement (https://medium.com/@navneet.ts/azure-reqests-using-postman-test-scripts-and-environment-variables-f37bb23adabb?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e6a01de1d4-EMAIL_NEWSLETTER_2017_06_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e6a01de1d4-10520483)
* Mark Winteringham recently published his Postman cheat sheet to Automating APIs (http://www.mwtestconsultancy.co.uk/postman-cheat-sheet/?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e6a01de1d4-EMAIL_NEWSLETTER_2017_06_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e6a01de1d4-10520483)
* Unmesh Gundecha writes about testing REST APIs by setting up an AWS CodePipline to run Postman Collections (https://unmesh.me/2017/06/10/api-testing-with-postman-collections-in-aws-codepipeline/?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e6a01de1d4-EMAIL_NEWSLETTER_2017_06_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e6a01de1d4-10520483)

Looking for more blogs on API development? Check out our community content page (https://www.getpostman.com/community-archive?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e6a01de1d4-EMAIL_NEWSLETTER_2017_06_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e6a01de1d4-10520483) .

subject: February News from Postman
snippet: February Postman News: The Postman Annual API Survey Is Here Postman Annual API Survey We are excited to announce the first ever Postman Annual API Survey. We know the Postman Community contains many
body:
February Postman News: The Postman Annual API Survey Is Here

https://www.getpostman.com/?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e9af1dbef2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2017_02_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e9af1dbef2-10520483
Postman Annual API Survey
We are excited to announce the first ever Postman Annual API Survey. We know the Postman Community contains many thousands of API experts, and we want to gather and share learnings about our common passion: API development. We would love for everyone to take the survey - we will keep all responses complete confidential and anonymize any shared results. We’ll share results with everyone in just a few weeks.
Take the Survey > (https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/R7X8ZP6)
Live in the Bay Area? Come to the first ever Postman After-Hours
If you live in the Bay Area, the Postman Team would love to meet you. Join us for our very first Postman After-Hours meetup on Thursday, February 23, at 6:00 p.m. in San Francisco. Abhinav Asthana, Postman's CEO and co-founder, will be speaking on one of his favorite topics: Tips and tricks to make your API development easier, faster, and better. Postman developers will also be on hand to answer individual questions about the Postman toolchain. Food and drink will be provided, but the best part is...it's free!
Reserve Your Spot > (https://www.eventbrite.com/e/come-visit-postman-in-san-francisco-tickets-31942394562?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e9af1dbef2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2017_02_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e9af1dbef2-10520483)
Key Postman Pro Integrations Announced
Want to broadcast the results of your API monitors on a slack channel? How about use APIMatic’s API transformer to convert documentation formats directly from Postman?

We’re working to provide great integrations to extend the power and utility of Postman Pro. Click on the Postman blog posts below to find out more about two great integrations. More to come!
Slack Integration (http://blog.getpostman.com/2017/02/08/introducing-a-new-integration-postman-pro-slack/?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e9af1dbef2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2017_02_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e9af1dbef2-10520483) | APIMatic Integration (http://blog.getpostman.com/2017/02/15/new-postman-pro-integration-apimatics-api-transformer/?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e9af1dbef2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2017_02_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e9af1dbef2-10520483)
Chrome Apps Are Being Deprecated in 2017
Chromium announced plans to phase out support for Chrome apps. You can visit our Chrome App deprecation blogpost (http://blog.getpostman.com/2016/08/23/using-the-postman-chrome-app-implications-from-the-recent-google-announcement/?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e9af1dbef2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2017_02_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e9af1dbef2-10520483) for more information on how this will affect the Postman toolchain and learn about the benefits (https://www.getpostman.com/docs/why_native?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e9af1dbef2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2017_02_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e9af1dbef2-10520483) of installing the Postman native app. Find Out More > (http://blog.getpostman.com/2016/08/23/using-the-postman-chrome-app-implications-from-the-recent-google-announcement/?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e9af1dbef2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2017_02_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e9af1dbef2-10520483)
Autograph your APIs with eSignLive & Postman
eSignLive has released a how-to blog series about using Postman, its ease of use, and how it helps with development for their API suite. Find the entire series below:
Part 1 (https://www.esignlive.com/blog/esignlive-how-to-using-postman/?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e9af1dbef2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2017_02_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e9af1dbef2-10520483) | Part 2 (https://www.esignlive.com/blog/use-postman?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e9af1dbef2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2017_02_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e9af1dbef2-10520483)
Get the Lowdown on the API Backend with Jeff Madsen
Jeff Madsen, head of Mahana Designs, has a new blog on Medium.com about using Postman Environment Variables & auth tokens for backend development. If you’re currently coding backend APIs, or are just looking for some quick development tips, check out the article and find out why Jeff says that Postman is “one of Mahana Designs’ most critical” tools.
Read The Blog > (https://medium.com/@codebyjeff/using-postman-environment-variables-auth-tokens-ea9c4fe9d3d7?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e9af1dbef2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2017_02_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e9af1dbef2-10520483#.4txd0uvn4)
Quovo Uses Postman to Simplify API Development
When Quovo wanted to simplify development for their account aggregation APIs, they turned to Postman. Using Postman Collections they were able to “securely share, sync and collaborate with developers using our Account Aggregation API.” Learn why “Postman will become a welcome addition to any developer’s toolkit” in their new how-to blog.
Read The Full Blog Post > (https://www.quovo.com/blog/postman-and-quovo/?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e9af1dbef2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2017_02_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e9af1dbef2-10520483)
Automate Your Testing With the CodeMentor
Is it taking hours to test APIs one at a time? The Postman Collections Runner can help with that. In this blog from the Postman community, Emanuel Quimper writes “I see a lot of people just using it as a manual tester. This is not wrong but you can get much better productivity if you use some of Postman features.” Learn how to use the Postman Collection Runner to automate your testing.
Read The Blog > (https://www.codementor.io/equimper/testing-your-api-with-postman-4tuwpkswp?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=e9af1dbef2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2017_02_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-e9af1dbef2-10520483)

subject: December News from Postman: Introducing Postman Pro
snippet: December 2016 Postman Newsletter: Introducing Postman Pro Postman Pro is here: We're excited to announce that Postman Pro, our updated API development toolchain, was released last week. The Pro
body:
December 2016 Postman Newsletter: Introducing Postman Pro

https://www.getpostman.com/?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=29ec970b55-NEWSLETTER_2016_12_21&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-29ec970b55-10520483

Postman Pro is here:
We’re excited to announce that Postman Pro, our updated API development toolchain, was released last week. The Pro toolchain expands upon Postman cloud by adding cloud collaboration, improving collection documentation & publishing, and taking our Postman monitoring tool out of beta. The new Postman Pro will allow API developers to leverage the power of Postman throughout every link in the API toolchain.

Postman Pro is designed to anticipate the API developer’s needs, and most features are implemented seamlessly enough to be set up with just a few clicks. The launch has been very exciting for us all, and we are proud to see the positive response our valued API development community has voiced for this release.

For more info, check out Postman CEO Abhinav Asthana’s new blog post (http://blog.getpostman.com/2016/12/15/introducing-postman-pro/?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=29ec970b55-NEWSLETTER_2016_12_21&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-29ec970b55-10520483) giving an overview of Pro’s new features, or head over to the product page (https://www.getpostman.com/products?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=29ec970b55-NEWSLETTER_2016_12_21&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-29ec970b55-10520483) on our website.

Postman Pro Press Roundup:
The media continues to weigh in on Postman Pro, and they’re as excited as we are. Here are a few of our favorite responses:

IT Business Edge (http://www.itbusinessedge.com/blogs/it-unmasked/postman-simplifies-process-of-managing-api-development.html?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=29ec970b55-NEWSLETTER_2016_12_21&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-29ec970b55-10520483) writes that in an “In an era when usage of APIs is approaching unprecedented levels, the management of the workflow process associated with developing hundreds, sometimes even thousands, of APIs has become exceedingly complex. To bring some order to the API chaos, Postman this week launched a platform for managing the toolchain associated with creating APIs.”

SDX Central (https://www.sdxcentral.com/articles/news/postman-releases-postman-pro-provide-api-monitoring/2016/12/?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=29ec970b55-NEWSLETTER_2016_12_21&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-29ec970b55-10520483) reports, “Postman Pro also extends the toolchain capabilities—including collaboration features, documentation and publishing, or monitoring—throughout the entire lifecycle of an API.”

Finally, In an interview with Programmable web (http://www.programmableweb.com/news/new-postman-pro-features-api-monitoring-documentation-generation-and-collaboration-tools/brief/2016/12/14?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=29ec970b55-NEWSLETTER_2016_12_21&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-29ec970b55-10520483) , Postman founder and CEO Abhinav Asthana explains, “Developers want to be able to build, document, and deploy APIs as fast and efficiently as possible. Postman Pro is designed to help developers do just that.”

Supercharge Your APIs With Collections:
Looking for a better way to keep track of your thousands of API calls? Our collections feature lets you take related API calls and group them together into a single “collection” file. Once you’ve grouped them together you can share them with your team (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mVTsK6ZdY6c&utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=29ec970b55-NEWSLETTER_2016_12_21&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-29ec970b55-10520483) , run scripts or tests with Postman’s collection runner (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QqeTZf5x3Is&utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=29ec970b55-NEWSLETTER_2016_12_21&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-29ec970b55-10520483) , or even automatically monitor API health with Postman Pro (https://www.getpostman.com/products?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=29ec970b55-NEWSLETTER_2016_12_21&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-29ec970b55-10520483) .

For more info on how to create collections, check out our documentation page (https://www.getpostman.com/docs/?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=29ec970b55-NEWSLETTER_2016_12_21&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-29ec970b55-10520483) or watch the video below:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bF8q8wvLs8A&list=PLM-7VG-sgbtD8qBnGeQM5nvlpqB_ktaLZ&autoplay=1&utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=29ec970b55-NEWSLETTER_2016_12_21&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-29ec970b55-10520483

Abhinav at API Days in Paris:
Postman CEO Abhinav Asthana recently visited the API Days conference in Paris to discuss simplifying API development. While there, he was interviewed by Jennifer Riggins about the state of API documentation.

In regards to Postman, Asthana explained “It’s not just a basic API REST Client anymore. It’s a much more controllable tool. Because documentation is actually integrated in it, you know what’s really going on...and basically Postman is a kind of tool that brings all of these jobs together.”

Find the full interview in the State of API Documentation 2017 white paper (http://bit.ly/2icHOkk?utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=29ec970b55-NEWSLETTER_2016_12_21&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-29ec970b55-10520483) on the API Days website. Note: Email address is required.

Community Updates:
Moltin Releases Postman Environment for Its E-Commerce Platform

Moltin, a cloud based eCommerce platform, has released a runtime environment for Postman. If you're looking for better ways to collaborate, document, and monitor APIs for your business, they've written a helpful blogpost on API onboarding (https://moltin.com/blog/2016/11/postman/?utm_source=Postman%20newsletter&utm_campaign=Postman%20collection&utm_medium=Email&utm_content=Postman%20Intro&utm_source=All+contacts&utm_campaign=29ec970b55-NEWSLETTER_2016_12_21&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_bba0cca85f-29ec970b55-10520483) for their app using Postman.

body:
Unsere Community ist im vergangenen Jahr signifikant gewachsen, daher aktualisieren wir unsere Nutzungsbedingungen, Zahlungsbedingungen und Datenschutzregeln (zusammengefasst "Bedingungen"). Die Änderungen treten für alle bestehenden Kunden am  7. Dezember 2016 in Kraft. Wenn du unsere Seite an diesem Tag oder in der Zeit danach nutzt, werden wir dich bitten, den neuen Bedingungen zuzustimmen. Wir haben außerdem unsere Richtlinien für Rückerstattungen an Gäste und unsere Bedingungen für die Gastgeber-Garantie aktualisiert. Die neuen Versionen treten am  7. Dezember 2016 für bestehende Kunden in Kraft.

Hier kannst du dir die neuen Bedingungen durchlesen. Wir haben auf unserer Seite für die Nutzungsbedingungen außerdem einige Informationen bereitgestellt, um diese Änderungen ausführlich zu erklären. Bis  7. Januar 2017 findest du sowohl die alte als auch die neue Version der Bedingungen unter den Reitern Nutzungsbedingungen, Zahlungsbedingungen, Datenschutzregeln, Richtlinien für Rückerstattungen an Gäste und Bedingungen für die Gastgeber-Garantie. Bitte lies diese Dokumente sorgfältig durch.

Insbesondere nehmen wir einige betriebliche Änderungen an unserem Unternehmen in China (Hongkong, Macau und Taiwan nicht einbezogen) (“China”) vor. Ab dem  7. Dezember 2016 wird unser Geschäft in China von Airbnb Internet (Beijing) Co., Ltd. (“Airbnb China”) betrieben. Dies bedeutet: Wenn du ein oder mehrere Inserate in China hast, werden Teile deiner Daten gemäß den chinesischen Gesetzen und Bestimmungen, darunter auch Datenschutzgesetze und Gesetze zum Schutz der Privatsphäre, an Airbnb China weitergeleitet sowie von Airbnb China gespeichert und verarbeitet ab dem  7. Dezember 2016. Was das für dich heißt, erfährst du hier.

Wenn du nach dem  7. Dezember 2016 eine bestimmte Aktion ausführen willst, aufgrund derer persönliche Daten von dir an Airbnb China weitergeleitet sowie von Airbnb China gespeichert und verarbeitet werden würden, erscheint ein entsprechender Hinweis bevor eine solche Weiterleitung, Speicherung, Nutzung oder Verarbeitung durchgeführt wird.

Wie Hotels und alle in China ansässigen Unternehmen ist Airbnb China an örtliche Gesetze und Bestimmungen gebunden, darunter auch Datenschutzgesetze und Gesetze zum Schutz der Privatsphäre. Airbnb China kann von chinesischen Regierungsbehörden verpflichtet werden, gespeicherte Informationen offenzulegen, darunter auch Informationen über Gastgeber, Gäste und Aufenthalte in China. Wenn du Airbnb weiterhin benutzen willst, aber nicht möchtest, dass deine Daten an Airbnb China übertragen sowie von Airbnb China gespeichert und weiterverarbeitet werden, solltest du alle von dir inserierten Unterkünfte in China in deinem Airbnb-Account löschen.

Laut unseren Aufzeichnungen liegt dein Wohnsitz nicht in China. Aktualisiere bitte die Bereiche "Wohnort" in Deinem Profil und die Angabe "Wohnsitzland" in deinen Account-Einstellungen, falls dein Wohnsitz in China liegen sollte. body:
Das Airbnb-Community-Bekenntnis
Hallo,

im Verlauf des Jahres haben wir umfassende Anstrengungen unternommen, um Vorurteile und Diskriminierung in der Airbnb-Community zu bekämpfen. Als Ergebnis dieser Bemühungen bitten wir ab dem 1. November 2016 alle unsere Mitglieder, das Airbnb-Community-Bekenntnis zu akzeptieren. Deine Einwilligung zu dieser Verpflichtung wird die Art und Weise verändern, wie du Airbnb nutzt. Deshalb möchten wir dir nähere Informationen dazu geben.

Was ist das Airbnb-Community-Bekenntnis?

Du erklärst dich bereit, jeden – unabhängig von Rasse, Religion, Herkunft, Volkszugehörigkeit, einer Behinderung, Geschlecht, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung oder Alter – respektvoll, vorurteilsfrei und unvoreingenommen zu behandeln.

Wie kann ich dem Bekenntnis zustimmen?

Am oder nach dem 1. November zeigen wir dir die Verpflichtungserklärung, wenn du dich einloggst oder die Airbnb-Website bzw. die App auf deinem Handy oder Tablet öffnest. Dann werden wir dich automatisch darum bitten, der Erklärung zuzustimmen.

Was passiert, wenn ich dem Bekenntnis nicht zustimme?

Wenn du dem Bekenntnis nicht zustimmst, kannst du nicht als Gastgeber auf Airbnb fungieren oder über Airbnb verreisen. Du hast dann die Möglichkeit, deinen Account zu löschen. Wenn dein Account gelöscht ist, werden gebuchte Aufenthalte storniert. Du kannst die Airbnb-Website dann weiterhin durchstöbern, aber du kannst keine Buchungen mehr durchführen oder Gäste aufnehmen.

Was soll ich tun, wenn ich Feedback zum Community-Bekenntnis habe?

Du kannst uns gerne Rückmeldung zur Verpflichtungserklärung und zu unseren Bemühungen hinsichtlich der Nichtdiskriminierung geben. Du kannst dir auch weitere Informationen über das Community-Bekenntnis durchlesen. Zusätzlich kannst du uns unter allbelong@airbnb.com kontaktieren.
https://www.airbnb.de/help/topic/533?eluid=0&euid=f5aa50a6-0791-6809-c922-9b3cc670c27c

snippet: New Features, Blogs, and Announcements .... Google Ending Support for Chrome Apps Last month, Google announced plans to sunset Chrome apps over the next 18 months. Never fear, if you use the Postman
body:
New Features, Blogs, and Announcements ....

Google Ending Support for Chrome Apps

Last month, Google announced plans to sunset Chrome apps over the next 18 months. Never fear, if you use the Postman Chrome app, there's plenty of time to transition to our Mac or Windows app. Read Postman's take on the announcement here. http://blog.getpostman.com/2016/08/23/using-the-postman-chrome-app-implications-from-the-recent-google-announcement/

Voucherify Rediscovers Postman

Think you know Postman? Voucherify recently brushed up on Postman Cloud's expanded features, supporting their entire API workflow:

“$5 per month for all these features?

That's what we call super cost to benefit ratio.”

Try out the super benefit to cost ratio with a free trial of Postman Cloud. https://www.getpostman.com/pricing#cloud-free-trial-30 Or, read Voucherify's super blog post http://www.voucherify.io/blog/2016/8/31/postman-really-supercharges-your-api, covering testing, collaboration, variables, and more.

Need to Learn (not Rediscover) Postman?

David Creedy wrote a terrific series of detailed articles on Streamlining API Testing with Postman. He covers everything from history to collections to headers to creating tests. Get started with Part 1 https://blog.matrix42.com/2016/08/08/api-testing-postman-part-1/ of the 3-part series.

Intuit Rolls out Postman for QuickBooks Online APIs

Intuit has provided a Postman collection for QuickBooks! Jarred Keneally, from the Intuit developer group, wrote a detailed blog post https://developer.intuit.com/hub/blog/2016/09/19/introducing-postman-quickbooks-online-api outlining how to get started with the Quickbooks Online Postman collection, or dig straight into the documentation here. https://developer.intuit.com/docs/0100_quickbooks_online/0100_essentials/0085_develop_quickbooks_apps/0001_your_first_request/first_request_with_postman

CheerioJS in the Postman Sandbox

Postman substituted CheerioJS for JQuery in the scripting sandbox with the latest release of the Mac app and Newman.

“With all these additions, Postman users now have consistent, blazing fast, scripting sandbox inside Postman that works cross-platform and is unaffected by browser quirks or versioning differences.”

Read all the details in the blog post. http://blog.getpostman.com/2016/08/30/jquery-replaced-by-cheeriojs-in-postman-sandbox/

The Postman Console

The latest Postman for Mac app includes the Postman Console, a new feature much-loved around the Postman office. Postman Console is analogous to a browser's version of developer console, except it is tuned for API development. Details — where else? — in a blog post. http://blog.getpostman.com/2016/08/26/the-postman-console/

IBM Deploys the Run in Postman Button

The Run in Postman Button allows API publishers to share documentation, illustrate use cases, and onboard developers quickly - and now you can use it with IBM's MobileFirst Platform in IBM Cloud. Learn different methods to test and debug adapters in this overview https://mobilefirstplatform.ibmcloud.com/tutorials/en/foundation/8.0/adapters/testing-and-debugging-adapters/ from IBM.

subject: Postman Product Updates
snippet: Hi there, Greetings from the Postman team! We have lots of news from the past few months about our product and community. Postman Cloud: Access Control, Notifications, and Activity Feed For
body:
Hi there,

Greetings from the Postman team! We have lots of news from the past few months about our product and community.

Postman Cloud: Access Control, Notifications, and Activity Feed

For professional teams collaborating on APIs, Postman provides a powerful tool called Postman Cloud. Postman has released tons of new team functionality https://www.getpostman.com/docs/cloud in Postman Cloud over the past few months - including the three most requested by customers: access control, notifications, and activity feeds.

Haven't tried Postman Cloud yet? Try it for 30 days, free. https://www.getpostman.com/pricing#cloud-free-trial-30

Early Adopters: Get Postman Canary

Want to use the latest and greatest? Postman has released a canary version of the Postman Mac App, which is based on an entirely new underlying layer of code called Postman Runtime. Runtime will provide a more powerful and consistent Postman experience once it's rolled into production.

Read more http://blog.getpostman.com/2016/06/14/introducing-postman-runtime-more-power-better-control/ about Runtime and how to get Postman Canary.

Creating Postman Collections 

Postman users create a lot of Collections! In June, the community created more than 170,000 Collections every week - nearly double the number created every week at the beginning of the year.

Haven't created a Collection yet? Nathan Haines of Object Partners published a great blog post https://objectpartners.com/2016/07/12/working-with-the-postman-rest-client/ outlining how he uses Postman, including Postman Collections, to build, run, test, and share API requests.

Nathan writes: “I wanted to create this blog post as a quick Postman primer, to showcase some of its shining features.” Thanks, Nathan - we couldn't have said it better ourselves!

Postman Community

subject: What Is Robert Kiyosaki Afraid Of?
snippet: Last week, we asked you to ask yourself if you were afraid to grow. Maybe not an easy question, since
body:
Last week, we asked you to ask yourself if you were afraid to grow. Maybe not an easy question, since it takes effort, sometimes risk, and the ability to overcome fear. To help you keep growing in your life and your financial education, we wanted to extend our invitation to you to schedule your Free Strategy Session and get your FREE special report. See the email below for more details.



What Is Robert Kiyosaki Afraid Of?

Dear Holger,

As a Rich Dad enthusiast, you probably think that Robert is pretty fearless. And you'd be right...except for one fear. And it's one that drives his behavior.

One of Robert's biggest fears is not continuing to grow his skills, insights and knowledge. In fact, he believes stopping to grow personally and intellectually is the equivalent of dying. After all, if you aren't growing, developing new skills, you'll soon find yourself further behind, less able to compete and with fewer options and choices under your control.

Ironically, most people's biggest fear is the polar opposite of Robert's. They are afraid of growth. Why? Because growth requires change, growth demands continuous learning, growth requires discipline and focus, growth is an intensive process and, finally, growth requires you to accept some risk.

 

 

Ask yourself...are you afraid to grow? Are you actually afraid to take the action that has the potential to change your life?

If so, don't see that as a negative. It's how most people feel and why most people don't break out and find success. So what should you do?

Easy. Set aside a few minutes and commit to participating in a one-on-one FREE Personal Success Strategy Session. All you have to do is click here.

Your strategy session will be conducted with a member of the Rich Dad Coaching Team. Your session will require truthful answers. It might even challenge you to think in new and different ways about your future. And we hope it will be an illuminating and interesting experience.

There is no cost or obligation for your free Success Strategy Session, but there is a bonus. Just for signing up, we'll send you one of Rich Dad's most powerful reports, The Ultimate Guide for Making Money. This eye-opening, practical report will help you develop the mindset to become a money maker. And like the Success Strategy Session, it is absolutely free.

Now it's up to you...but only if you take action.

The Rich Dad Coaching Team

Are You a Victim or a Hero?

Dear Holger,

A victim is someone who blames others or circumstances for his or her situation. They don't take responsibility, they think "poor me" and relinquish control of their life to others or just rely on chance.

In contrast, a hero faces his fears head-on, understands that success requires risk and failure is a possibility, but the reward is often well worth the risk.

Stated another way, heroes accept the hand they have been dealt and play it to win, doing whatever it takes to try and create positive results. Victims blame their luck and fold. Victims give up. Heroes never do.

 

 

It is this attitude that is the fundamental difference between victims and heroes, failure and success. And your attitude is something you can control. It's a skill that you can learn. In fact, it is a skill that 99% of all successful people have, cultivate and use to their benefit.

And when you have the right attitude you can take the right actions. After all, without action all you have are meaningless dreams.

Here is a suggestion for an action you can take right now that could change your future. Request your free copy of our latest special report, 7 Steps to Master Your Financial Future. It comes with a free introduction to Rich Dad Coaching, which is where the real life change will happen. Simply put, it is the fastest and easiest way for you to become a "hero" in life.

Beginne die Entdeckungsreise: https://www.airbnb.de?eluid=2&euid=e47cc550-9fdc-a59c-4420-16c00e493ff4

Subject: OTA - partial resolution -its all about the numbers -

Hello,

Goods news, we are partially out of the woods on the OTA. Its all about the numbers.
Note as we have stayed with the problem and  have  identified two issues:

1) Routing issues in the Cubic network - MSISDNs assigned to AUDI and other products
2) MISDSN ranges used that are not in our IR.21

The issue related to our IR.21 is it does not reflect the 12,14,15  ranges we are using.

The IR.21, is our outward facing description of our network, this does not have an immediate resolution.
To mitigate this we must limit the numbers we use with Audi for next two weeks until other networks become aware of our full ranges and update their routing.

An update on the OTA issues:
An update to our routing to include 12,14,15 ranges was required to make the SIMs from that MSISDN reachable.
The problem cars were all in those ranges.

This routing update was done this morning and we see the signalling issues resolved.


Summary:
Cubic have ranges from 4236510,11,13 according to our IR.21.
For voice and SMS for 4236510 and 1 has been used to date.
We have data only for 12…5. So SMS or voice was not used in these ranges and not an issue.


Problem:
OTA uses SMS. The cards that had problems are in the 12,14,15 ranges are not reachable.

Resolution impact:
Below here is a picture of what signalling that looks like after we put in the change, the drop is attributable to looping issue being removed.

Next steps:
1) Issue IR.21 to operators with 12,14,15 ranges numbers included. (NOC Regulatory) (owner James D)
2) Test 12,14,15  number ranges for SMS and Voice before using in a product. (NOC Regulatory) (owner James D)

Note: No product that uses 12,14,15 number ranges  can be OTA’d until the next steps are resolved.


Thanks to all who helped to get to this point, very much a collaborative effort across Cubic.

A special thank you to Holger who came to our aid at no notice and gave up Friday evening to help on top of facilitating us through a vacation the previous Monday.



Regards

James Dennis

snippet: Cut distractions and take action Don't let feedback loops, meetings, or interruptions slow you
body:
Cut distractions and take action. 

Don't let feedback loops, meetings, or interruptions slow you down. Learn how with these 3 articles, then head over to Asana to get things done (http://connect.asana.com/1L9Q-3KURJ-IVOBX5-1QB7QE-0/c.aspx


1. HOW TO KILL OVER-COMMUNICATION: A MEMO FROM OUR FOUNDERS 

Avoid consensus. Skip meetings. Let go of control. This internal memo changed the way that we're communicating at Asana.

Read more » ( http://connect.asana.com/1L9Q-3KURJ-IVOBX5-1QB61E-0/c.aspx )


2. WHEN BAD MEETINGS HAPPEN TO GOOD PEOPLE 

From the casual sync to the routine weekly status update, we break down 5 classic meeting faux pas and show you how to fix them.

Read more » ( http://connect.asana.com/1L9Q-3KURJ-IVOBX5-1QB61G-0/c.aspx )


3. THE 4-STEP GUIDE TO ELIMINATING DISTRACTIONS 

You may think that to be a good teammate, you have to respond to things immediately. But sometimes not reacting might be a better plan.

Read more » ( http://connect.asana.com/1L9Q-3KURJ-IVOBX5-1QB61I-0/c.aspx )

body:
Follow this guide to take advantage of the rest of your summer while being a productive teammate at work.

=======

SUNSHINE

Enjoyed most when outside of the office

Work more productively with these 4 scheduling techniques, so you can get out to enjoy the longer, sunnier days: http://connect.asana.com/1L9Q-3IJ44-IVOBX5-1OAX91-0/c.aspx 

=======

VACATION

Key to recharging, but can slow down team projects

Delegate tasks to teammates in Asana ( http://connect.asana.com/1L9Q-3IJ44-IVOBX5-1OAX92-0/c.aspx ) before leaving, so they can keep things moving and you can unplug without worry.

=======

A GOOD READ 

Sharpens leadership skills; pairs well with lemonade

Get a fresh perspective on teamwork with lessons, stories & ideas from great leaders on Asana's Workstyle blog: ( http://connect.asana.com/1L9Q-3IJ44-IVOBX5-1OAX93-0/c.aspx )

=======

LOUNGE CHAIR

Highly recommended for unwinding

Simplify and relax. Leo Babauta of Zen Habits shares how to bring mindfulness to your team, work, and life ( http://connect.asana.com/1L9Q-3IJ44-IVOBX5-1OAX94-0/c.aspx ).

subject: FW: Voxbone Account
snippet: Hallo Ralf, Holger, Wer kennt unsere DIDs und kann die Frage unten beantworten? Ansonsten versuchen
body:
Hallo Ralf, Holger,
Wer kennt unsere DIDs und kann die Frage unten beantworten? Ansonsten versuchen wir gerade, den bestehenden Voxbone-Vertrag mit Dev. Garden auf unsere (T-Labs) Kostenstelle umzuschreiben. Hoffentlich klappt das.
VG
Joachim


From: Beinecke, Judith
Sent: Mittwoch, 22. April 2015 12:05
To: Stegmann, Joachim
Cc: Gentsch, Isabel
Subject: AW: Voxbone Account

Hallo Herr Stegmann,

hier kommen nun alle Informationen, die ich bis jetzt zusammentragen konnte. Ich denke, sie sind recht vollständig. Nur bezüglich des Vorgehens bei der Abrechnung warte ich noch auf eine Rückmeldung unserer Teamassistenz, die momentan außer Haus ist.


Vertrag und Abrechnung:

Der Vertrag mit Voxbone wurde zwischen der Deutsche Telekom AG und Voxbone geschlossen, sodass ich davon ausgehe, dass man den Vertrag für die Übernahme inhaltlich nicht ändern muss. Alle Dokumente, die mir dazu vorliegen, finden Sie im Anhang.

Die Excel Datei bei den Vertragsunterlagen enthält die Preise (im Reiter "VoxDID").
Für jede DID gibt es eine einmalige Setup-Fee, die dem monatlichen Preis der DID entspricht bis auf Kanada und Deutschland. Für diese beiden Länder ist die Setup-Fee unterschiedlich zur monatlichen Gebühr. Dies ist auch in der Preisliste beschrieben.

Einen Basispreis für die Nutzung von Voxbone gibt es nicht. Das "Monthly Spending Commitment" bezeichnet lediglich die Preiskategorie. Sollten Sie jemals mehr als 5000 EUR pro Monat an Voxbone zahlen, würden Sie in eine andere Preiskategorie eingeordnet werden.

Das interne Vorgehen bezüglich der Bezahlung der DIDs ist, soweit ich aktuell weiß, wie üblich:

-          Eine Bestellung für Ihre Kostenstelle muss vorliegen, damit die Voxbone Rechnungen gezahlt werden können.


Offen

Anfang Juli müssen wir dann den Voxbone Account an Sie übergeben und dort die Rechnungsadresse anpassen, sodass die Rechnungen an Sie gestellt werden und nicht mehr an uns.


Zum aktuellen Stand

Momentan haben Sie ca. 179 DIDs beantragt. Eine Liste finden Sie im Anhang. Bei einigen bin ich mir nicht sicher, ob Sie zu Ihnen gehören. Diese habe ich farblich markiert. Eine Bitte: Es wäre nett, wenn Sie diese überprüfen lassen könnten und mir eine Rückmeldung darüber geben, ob diese T-Labs DIDs sind. Diese Information benötige ich, da ich alle DIDs, die nicht zu Ihnen gehören Ende Juni stilllegen muss. Vielen Dank schon mal dafür!


Ich hoffe, diese Informationen geben Ihnen einen ausreichenden Überblick über alle wichtigen Themen bzgl. Voxbone. Wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben sollten, gerne!

Viele Grüße
Judith Beinecke

Gesendet: Dienstag, 21. April 2015 15:59
An: Beinecke, Judith
Cc: Gentsch Isabel, TP-ET
Betreff: RE: Voxbone Account

Danke vorab für Ihre Bemühungen.
Viele Grüße,
Joachim Stegmann

From: Beinecke, Judith
Sent: Dienstag, 21. April 2015 10:15
To: Stegmann, Joachim
Cc: Gentsch, Isabel
Subject: AW: Voxbone Account

Hallo Herr Stegmann,

die Informationen bezüglich der Preisgestaltung, des Vertrags und der Abrechnung, habe ich bei meinen Kollegen angefragt. Sobald ich alles beisammen habe, werde ich Ihnen alle Details dazu zukommen lassen. Ich denke, das wird spätestens nächste Woche der Fall sein.

body:
Having trouble reading this email? View it in your browser.

Greetings Holger,

We all have fear.
Fear in small doses is healthy, but when fear goes unchecked for too
long…

A HUGE part of emotional intelligence is managing fear. How many times have
you let fear stop
you from taking action? How many times has fear kept your from following
your passion and
finding happiness.

Fear can crush your spirit. If your spirit is weakened your health is
weakened, your happiness is
impossible and you begin to lash out at the people around you. Fear is
toxic.

Anik’s message is about PASSION and feeding passion is one of the best
ways to starve fear.

Listen to Anik's message and enjoy his FREE gift.

One of the greatest fears is the fear of not having money. People don't
confront this fear logically,
they react emotionally and end up making mistakes.

But if you have emotional intelligence, when the fear of not having enough
money arises, instead
of immediately running out to get a job, you might ask yourself ‘Is a job
the best solution over the
long run?’ the answer is no. A job is a short-term solution to a
long-term problem.

The solution is not to have a job, but to have an asset. This is why the
rich do not work for
money. The rich work to build and obtain assets like a business or real
estate.

You can use your passion as fuel to start a small business. When you mix
your passion with
knowledge you have two key ingredients to defeating fear.

Below is another free gift from Anik, a video that shows you how to take
your passion and create
a thriving business, all from the comfort of your own home.

This is new to me (in my day we actually left the house and knocked on
doors) but Anik has
made it easier than I ever thought possible. So my advice... just watch the
video and decide
for yourself.

Learn how to build your online business now!

To making life better,

email we discussed that

personal growth.
This holds true for day to day life as well.

In addition to book smarts you’re going to need emotional intelligence
and emotional maturity.

If you are being smothered by bad debt, you’ll need to train and study to
get out from under it
and you’ll need information on investing so you can see and take
advantage of your choices...
or even better, create your own choices.

Studying alone does you no good. Study that does not motivate action
isn’t useful, its intellectual
vanity. It’s just something to make you feel better about yourself
without taking any risk.

1.       Place a US city or zip (postal) code in the white box on the homepage.
2.       Click Search

You see others take advantage of them and think, “Why not me?” It’s
so much easier to sit back
and watch someone else take the risk, isn’t it? I’m not making excuses
for you, but I understand.
What happens if you fail, better not to try at all right?

Everyone has hardships and difficulties. For some debt. From others it’s
an unsupportive spouse.
For some it’s time…or money…or fear… or belief. There are infinite
obstacles to success. But
there are just as many opportunities. What if you could shift your mind to
see the opportunities
instead of the obstacles?

A few years back, my wife Kim and I took high performance driving lessons.
Learning to drive at
200mph was empowering, but it was also terrifying. Every time I rounded a
corner I would take
my foot off the gas. My instructor would tell me to speed up, to push it
harder, but all I could hear
was my fear and self-doubt. My desire to push the envelope was drowned out
by fear of hitting
the wall.

Finally my instructor called me out. STOP LOOKING AT THE WALL AND FOCUS ON
WHERE
YOU ARE GOING!!!

I was still scared, but he was right. I had to stop focusing on the
obstacles and start focusing
on where you are going.

How do you push past your fear and focus on winning? I’ll give you some
tips in my next email.

Here's to making life better,
signature_robert.png
Robert Kiyosaki

Hallo Marc, Holger,

Ich denke, wir sollten diese technischen Fragen gemeinsam beantworten. ST ist doch derzeit unser wichtigster Kunde, oder? Ich bin morgen in Berlin, wie wäre es nach dem Sprint-Review?

Viele Grüße,
Joachim

From: Schumann Sebastian [mailto:sebastian.schumann@telekom.sk]
Sent: Dienstag, 2. Dezember 2014 15:49
To: Stegmann, Joachim
Cc: Matejka Juraj
Subject: Falcon questions supporting Slovak Telekom budget estimate

Dear Joachim

Nice to "meet" you, although not yet in person (I think we'll meet in person in Paris on the Upperside event). I'm working  with my colleagues from Slovak Telekom on the Falcon project and you were mentioned as counterpart that can answer a set of technical questions that are relevant for doing the necessary business case assumptions here in ST.

I'll just list the questions here, since we have little time (this week was mentioned as deadline to do the main work) I suppose we can do without more formal ways of submitting them.

Please provide the following information:

1.       Please provide a detailed overview over the Falcon features, incl. their implementation. Gil spoke last time about a prediction algorithm that choses the connection (2G vs. data) and whether to use WebRTC for example. We would need to know how it works in order to estimate the relations correctly. We need to know in particular

*  Is your solution virtualized (or parts of it - which ones)? Is it elastically scalable?

*  What is your WebRTC gateway? Is it backed by an IMS - what is the internal architecture of your systems to understand them a bit better?

*  Does the OCS have an API to integrate with our OCS or are integration efforts expected here?

*  What is the voice mail system?

*  Can ST be the payment provider - you have only public service providers listed.

*  Are the OSS modules integrated or integratable with DT common systems (or ST systems if easy APIs are available)

2.       How do you plan to solve LI (Lawful Intercept)? It will be a mandatory requirement, but that would mean that we need B2B media termination in the cloud for all users (since otherwise media traffic can pass our infrastructure only encrypted). This is assumed to be part of the delivery. The technical realization (location of that B2B cloud) needs also to be discussed later (preferably of course one PoP is also here in SK in the mid-term).

3.       What is part of your IT (OSS/BSS) delivery in detail? We need to calculate IT savings and thus would need to evaluate what we need, do not need, and potentially need to integrate.

4.       Do you have means to account prepaid customers? Those are not on a flat plan yet and would need to be addressed somehow - at least for the breakout minutes in real-time.  If no separate system, please let us know whether you have API or can integrate with an external prepaid engine, we would need then also a separate estimate on that from you to make it part of the BC.

5.       In order to address a large user base, we would require many

6.       We would require a cost item for a native iOS application that can communicate with the Falcon backend (wrapper around WebRTC APIs using native iOS APIs and notification integration etc. to make it work there).

7.       The following "supplementary service features" shall be supported. If we make this service the primary communications means of a user this is the regulated base line. Please indicate availability and effort if not.

*  Line ID (CLIP, CLIR, COLP, COLR)

*  Barring/Blocking (CB, ICB, OCB)

8.       The following "supplementary service features" should be supported, please indicate availability and effort if not.

*  Malicious caller id (MCID)

*  Ad-hoc Conference (CONF)

*  CCBS

*  Call forwarding (CFU, CFB, CFNR, CFNR offline)

*  Call Waiting (CW)

*  Call Hold

9.       How should number portability be solved on the side of Falcon? I assume Falcon is aware of its own numbers and sends all others out via the PSTN gateway, which is expected to do the lookup and route accordingly. Please confirm. We also need to address the problem for local numbers, i.e., if a user is "migrated to Falcon to find him there, or on 2G when he does not have reception. The whole problem needs to be described, perhaps you have already some thoughts about it (if not we can also commonly elaborate, just checking)...

10.   Please let us know if you have any expectations on interfaces on our side (e.g. ENUM for solving NP or SMS REST interface) so we know what you need but we don't have available.

11.   What are the required network APIs for ST (e.g. supplementary service control, SMS) and their respective protocols you expect them to have? Needs to be known if further investment needed or revenue impact if instead of ST some other provider is used (E2P or 3PTY).

12.   How can the VPN service (mobile business subscribers can dial short numbers within their virtual group, but only within there, kind of an alias) be realized? Please indicate availability and effort if not.

I did many of these question according my best knowledge as of this moment, please take into account that some of the assumptions or requirements may change also from our side (or questions become irrelevant). Some more questions may follow too, this was just the first set from the top of our heads to get the discussion started as soon as possible.

Please let us know if you have any question.

Thank you.

Best regards
Sebastian


--

subject: Learn How to Fail

body:
Having trouble reading this email? View it in your browser.

Greetings Holger,

There are a lot of great entrepreneurs out there, but one of my
favorites is Thomas Edison. I think I’m such a fan because, like
me, he failed so much more than he succeeded. Of course, he
learned how to turn those failures into golden lessons.

When I was a kid, we learned about Thomas Edison in school. When
I told my rich dad that we were studying Edison’s life, he asked
me if they’d taught me how he became so prolific. “No,” I replied.
“We only learned about how he invented the light bulb.” “Well,
I'm sorry to contradict your teacher,” rich dad said. “But, Thomas
Edison didn’t invent the light bulb.”

Rich dad explained that there were many other people who had
invented light bulbs before Edison. The problem was that these
light bulbs were not practical. They would die out too soon. Also,
these inventors could not explain why a light bulb was
commercially valuable.

In short, they had a great idea, but they didn’t have a business.
Edison, on the other hand, not only invented a better light bulb,
but he also built a business around it. He invented the first
useful light bulb and he knew how to show its value.

Anyone can have a great idea, but only a great entrepreneur can
make money with that idea. You probably have a great idea or
product too. Just about everyone does. But do you know how to
make money with it?

If you have the courage to pursue your idea, start with baby
steps. Start with research, talking to people and flushing out
your idea. Once you have figured out how to make money, THEN the
fun begins. But, start with step one.

Thank you for reading. As always, if you find value in these
emails, please share them with your friends.

Here's to making life better,
signature_robert.png

Robert Kiyosaki

subject: Today's SwiftKey news and a thank you gift
snippet: Hello everyone, Today, we're very excited to bring you a major update to SwiftKey Keyboard in the
body:
Hello everyone,
									
Today, we're very excited to bring you a major update to SwiftKey Keyboard in the Google Play store, which includes many new features that are a direct result of your feedback. To mark the occasion we're giving you a gift!
									
Consistently, our #1 user request is for a wider range of themes, the colors and designs that enable you to personalize your SwiftKey experience. With today's announcement, we're happy to bring you dozens of new free and premium themes, which can be accessed in the brand new SwiftKey Store. This is a great way for us to invest in quality design and let everyone get the most choice with their SwiftKey experience. In today's update there are now 48 themes in SwiftKey Keyboard, and more are coming soon.
									
To say thanks for your support as a paid SwiftKey user, we're giving you a 'Premier Pack' of 10 new premium themes worth $4.99 for free! Instructions on how to get these themes can be found here
									
Additional new features in SwiftKey Keyboard include:

- Support for over 800 emoji, plus a new emoji prediction feature
- Optional number row
- Enhanced Flow
- Improved prediction engine
- More languages
- ...and much more

To get this updated version of SwiftKey, head to (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.touchtype.swiftkey) Google Play and update for free.
									
Also, from today, SwiftKey Keyboard will be completely free to download on Google Play! We want to take a moment to give you a bit more information and explain some of the thinking behind this exciting change.

We've come an incredibly long way these past six years, from two university friends with an ambitious idea, to becoming the global best-selling app on Google Play the past two years running. We founded SwiftKey to make it easier for everyone to create and communicate on their mobile devices, and as a company we're working hard to reach that goal.

This is why today we are making SwiftKey free. We believe this change is the best way to achieve our global vision for SwiftKey, as we can now reach many more people around the world without price as a barrier. That said, we want to reassure you that the SwiftKey features you have come to know and love will remain yours.

As a final note, we'll be running a Reddit AMA to discuss the new SwiftKey Keyboard (and anything else you might want to bring up) in the near future. We'll announce specific time and date details in the days ahead, and really hope you'll take part.
									
Thank you, again, for your continued support,
									
Jon & Ben
SwiftKey co-founders

Importance: High

English version see below

Liebe Kolleginnen, liebe Kollegen,

wie bereits im ID Jour Fixe der letzten Woche informiert, ist es aufgrund eines Vorstandsbeschlusses notwendig alle IT-Systeme innerhalb der T-Labs zu identifizieren.
Der Beschluss sieht für alle Einheiten ein pro-aktives Security Patch Management vor. Alle Bereiche sind aufgefordert dies zeitnah umzusetzen, so dass wir im ersten Schritt alle Labs IT-Systeme intern identifizieren bevor wir dann gemeinsam Maßnahmen zur Umsetzung schaffen.
Aus diesem Grund möchte ich Euch bitten das beiliegende Excel-Template zur Datenerhebung zu verwenden, aktiv von jeweiligen Projekt/Projektfeld Input einzuholen und mir bis spätestens 28.03.2014 per email zu zusenden. Die Erhebung der Daten umfasst alle Systeme, welche wir selbst verwalten sowie die Systeme die wir ggf. extern beauftragt haben und somit verantworten. Bitte unterstützt diese vorbereitende Umfrage, um gemeinsam mit euch das geforderte pro-aktive Security Patch Management zu leben.

Vielen Dank und Beste Grüße
Sven

English version

Dear colleagues,

As we explained in the ID Jour Fixe meeting last week, owing to a decision by the board, we have to identify all of the IT systems within T-Labs. The decision also required that we take a more pro-active approach to the management of security patches.
All areas have been asked to implement this without delay. As a first step we need to identify all of the T-Labs internal IT systems, so that we can then develop joint measures for the implementation. This is why I would now ask you to use the attached Excel template to collect the data.
Please actively collect the required input from your projects and send it to me by email no later than 28 March 2014. The data to be collected includes all systems which we manage ourselves as well as external systems for which we are responsible.
Please help with this preparatory survey so that we can together make the best of this more pro-active management of security patches.

Thanks and Best, Sven

subject: AW: ... Erinnerung ;-) ...
snippet: Liebe Carmen, Na du scheinst ja auch etwas rum zu kommen, die Eifel und der Bodensee sind ja nun auch
body:
Liebe Carmen,

 

Na du scheinst ja auch etwas rum zu kommen, die Eifel und der Bodensee sind
ja nun auch nicht gerade auf der gleichen Strecke.

 

Find es spannend das du eine Freundin hast die eine Salsa-Schule hat.

 

Ich tingle weiter von Seminar zu Seminar, letztes Wochen Ende war ich bei
Michaela auf einem Seminar mit Andro, das war Super wir waren ca. 30 Leute
die auch alle schon Tanta Erfahrung hatten, Christa und Martina wahren auch
dabei J.

 

Tja, zu deiner Intimen Frage, das ist wirklich schwierig, erstens versuche
ich mich immer auf meine Partnerinn einzustellen und Sie  aus dem Gefühl
heraus zu berühren, beziehungsweise auf die Reaktionen zu achten, wenn ich
mich noch richtig erinner ist das eine Technik gewesen wo ich mit dem Rücken
des beider Mittelfinger in einer gleichbleibenden Geschwindigkeit über deine
Yoni und Klitoris gestrichen habe und danach deine Klitoris umrundet, der
Trick ist dabei die Geschwindigkeit bei zu behalten was mir einig Frauen
sagten wohl selber recht schwer ist weil die Erregung dazu führt das Sie
meist schneller werden.

 

Liebe Grüße,

 

Holger

 

 

 

 

Von: Carmen Noller [mailto:carmen-noller@t-online.de] 
Gesendet: Dienstag, 29. Oktober 2013 09:19
An: 'Holger Rannow'
Betreff: ... Erinnerung ;-) ...

 

Lieber Holger,

 

ja … Ferien waren ganz OK … 

Mein Sohn hat Down Syndrom, ist 11 Jahre alt und „frech wie OSKAR“ … und
seit er auf der Welt  ist gehen wir regelmäßig in dieses Therapiezentrum in
Baiersbronn und dort finden dann täglich unter Ergotherapeuten,
Krankengymnasten und Logopäden nach einem ganz präzisen Programm Therapien
statt – also mind. 3 x täglich. Da wir bereits routiniert sind und die
Abläufe, die Ferienwohnung und den Ort gut kennen, ist es eigentlich wie
Urlaub in einer schönen Landschaft parallel mit optimalen Betreuungs- und
Unterstützungszeiten für ihn.

Ich bin am WE vielleicht in Singen am Bodensee … da habe ich sehr gute
Freunde … und eine Freundin hat in Singen eine Salsa-Schule
<http://www.salsa-in-singen.de/kurse.php>
http://www.salsa-in-singen.de/kurse.php J.

Vielleicht ergibt sich ja spontan etwas … ich habe allerdings noch alles
offen und die Freunde dort wissen auch noch nichts von meinen Plänen …

Jetzt noch etwas Intim-Vertrauliches unter uns:

Ich kann mich leider schon gar nicht mehr detailliert erinnern, aber ich
will so so gerne praktisch wissen, wie Du mich vaginal-tantrisch berührt
hast an diesem einen Abend … das war ziemlich traumhaft … das Tempo und die
Berührungsart war total stimmig … ich sagte Dir das bereits … aber gerade
streift mich diese Erinnerung wieder und ich würde das gerne selbst gezielt
können und wissen, wie Du das gemacht hast! Tja … theoretisch wohl schwierig
zum Erklären, aber vielleicht gelingt es Dir dennoch …

 

So … jetzt fahre ich gleich los … ich gebe heute Nachmittag eine Schulung in
der Eiffel … und da besuche ich noch auf ein Stündchen Adrian (der
Glatzen-Mann, der vorne für die Technik zuständig war an unserem
Herbst-Seminar) und seine Frau, die normalerweise sonst auch immer bei den
Seminaren dabei ist.

 

Ganz lieben Gruß und hab einen richtig guten Tag,

Carmen

 

Von: Holger Rannow [mailto:holgerrannow@gmail.com] 
Gesendet: Dienstag, 22. Oktober 2013 23:54
An: 'Carmen Noller'
Betreff: AW: Bist du zu Hause gut empfangen worden?

 

Liebe Carmen,

 

Ich hoffe du konntest deine Ferien noch genießen, was für eine Therapie habt
ihr denn gemacht?

Ich  war ja  letzte Woche bei Daniel Odie auf einem Tantra-Yoga Seminar,
welches auch spannend war und nun muss ich auch mal wieder Arbeiten.

 

Im Moment sind Tantra und Salsa meine zwei großen Hobbys, aber letztens war
ich auch noch ein Wochenende klettern.

 

Ich bin und war noch nicht verheiratet und habe auch keine Kinder.

 

Liebe Grüße,

 

Holger

 

Von: Carmen Noller [mailto:carmen-noller@t-online.de] 
Gesendet: Donnerstag, 17. Oktober 2013 03:31
An: 'Holger Rannow'
Betreff: AW: Bist du zu Hause gut empfangen worden?

 

Lieber Holger,

 

schön, Deine Zeilen zu lesen und die Erinnerungen hoch kommen zu lassen.

Hier im Alltag bin ich noch etwas „weich-gespült“ unterwegs … bin gut
angekommen … uns geht’s gut … haben immer noch Ferien … und nun schon eine
Therapiewoche mit meinem Sohn im Schwarzwald hinter mir … PUHHH.

Ich habe nun das Protokoll dieser Seminartage auch fast fertig. Da fällt
einmal mehr auf, wie viel es beinhaltet hat.

 

Bist Du eigentlich in Deinem Alltag verliebt, verlobt oder verheiratet?
Kinder oder keine Kinder? Machst Du auch anderes in Deiner Freizeit außer
Tantra- und Kundalini-Seminare?

Tja … direkt … und neugierig … Du kommst bestimmt damit klar J.

 

Liebe Grüße durch die Nacht,

Carmen

 

 

Von: Holger Rannow [mailto:holgerrannow@gmail.com] 
Gesendet: Montag, 14. Oktober 2013 17:23
An: carmen-noller@t-online.de
Betreff: Bist du zu Hause gut empfangen worden?

 

Liebe Carmen,

 

Ich hoffe deine Kinder haben dich zuhause freudig empfangen.

 

Wie geht es dir nach dem Seminar?

 

Ich hatte erst mal eine Arbeitsreiche Woche und bin nun auf dem Weg zum
nächsten Seminar, mit einem kleinen Abstecher bei einem Freund dem wir Heute
einen Tantrischen Geburtstag beschert haben J.

 

Hat das Seminar noch Nachwirkungen bei dir? Ich bin fasziniert wie viele
Bausteine das Seminar für mich mal wieder aufgedeckt hat.

 

Liebe Grüße,

 

Holger

Ich wünsche mir eine Weg zu finden, dich einfach lieben zu dürfen, ohne
